basics.name: Zhuo Yu
basics.label: Research Associate, UKP Lab, TU Darmstadt
basics.summary: Graduate student at TU Darmstadt holding an M.Sc. in Computer Science (GPA 1.39, German scale) and finishing a second M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Over four years of research experience as a student and full-time research assistant in deep learning and NLP, with a co-authored EACL publication. Seeking a Ph.D. position for in-depth research in NLP, trustworthy AI, and interpretability.

work.company: Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing Lab (UKP), TU Darmstadt
work.summary: Conducted research on bias in machine-generated text detectors toward non-native English speakers, supervised by Prof. Rozovskaya.
highlights: Contributed to Project-CARE, an open-source annotation platform

work.company: Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing Lab (UKP), TU Darmstadt
work.summary: Extended master's research on detecting implicit relations between texts using Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
highlights: Extended the architecture with heterogeneous retriever and reader variants
Broadened benchmark coverage by integrating additional datasets
Designed joint training strategies including staged training of reranker, retriever, and reader

work.company: Trustworthy Human Language Technologies Lab (TrustHLT), TU Darmstadt
work.summary: Adapted and evaluated differentially-private training approaches across multiple NLP models and datasets (WMT16, BSD), contributing to the paper DP-NMT: Scalable Differentially-Private Machine Translation.
highlights: Resolved out-of-memory issues in the JAX training framework
Expanded the pipeline to support additional datasets

work.company: Produktionsmanagement, Technologie und Werkzeugmaschinen Lab (PTW), TU Darmstadt
work.summary: Applied deep learning to sensor data and welding machine configuration parameters to predict product quality and optimize machine configurations.
highlights: Implemented data augmentation for limited industrial data
Developed an Actor-Critic model via Stable-Baselines3 for configuration optimization
Refactored a GNN-based solution with GNNExplainer for interpretable predictions

work.company: Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing Lab (UKP), TU Darmstadt
work.summary: Teaching assistant for the master's course Foundations of Language Processing.
highlights: Answered student questions and graded homework via nbgrader

portfolio.name: Evaluating MGT Detector Bias: Native vs Non-Native English Authors
portfolio.description: Investigating whether machine-generated text detectors exhibit systematic bias against non-native English speakers in scientific writing.

portfolio.name: RAG for Implicit Relation Detection Between Texts (M.Sc. Thesis)
portfolio.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework to automate detection of implicit textual links, developed as M.Sc. thesis at UKP Lab.

portfolio.name: Identifying Contradicted Findings in ACL Anthology Papers
portfolio.description: Annotating and building a dataset to identify contradictions among NLP papers on the same topic, with model training and evaluation.
